_inspectorSnowReport.Report:
4/4 2:35PM - Sun’s out, fun’s out! Kicking off the weekend with sunshine and spring turns is the best way to do it. Stick around for some Easter laps tomorrow on 31 open trails, with 30 set to be smoothed out overnight. For your ride up, 4 lifts are scheduled to spin at 8:30 AM, though wind and weather related delays are expected.

Tomorrow, we’re expecting light rain throughout the day with a chance of lightning and summit winds reaching up to 55 mph. Additionally, mixed precipitation overnight could lead to icy conditions. Due to these factors, along with the need to pull cabins from the Gondola, the Easter Sunrise Summit Service has been canceled. For those of you in the area, services will be held at Chapel of the Snows located across the street from the Village at 3pm. 

After a bit of wet weather, colder windows are expected to move in this week, giving our all-star grooming team ideal conditions to resurface and refresh the mountain ahead of our last hurrah next weekend. There’s still plenty of stellar spring skiing to be had, so stay tuned for what’s to come. We’ll see you bright and early!

Safety Tip: Wind and showers expose spring hazards. 

Gather Outdoors is headed to Stratton April 11-12, for a weekend full of live music, spring skiing, and après all across the mountain. Expect house, bass, and jam across two stages, with music running all afternoon and into the night. It’s one of the best late-season weekends to make a few spring laps, then head straight to the music. If you’re planning to stay for the weekend, lodging will fill up quickly, so book Gather lodging now!

Lock in next season’s fun with a 26/27 Ikon Pass, officially on sale now. Here’s the best part– when you buy next season’s pass, you can ride the rest of this season too! Be sure to check out the season pass page to lock it in.

Reliable cars are the name of the game; that is why we trust Oliver Subaru and Ford. Made for all seasons and all families, check out Oliver Ford and Oliver Subaru for year-round reliability!

Stay and relish the Green Mountains! Stratton Real Estate is here to help with all your real estate needs. Make your sweet escape a reality.
